16:57 Local Time, 14:57 GMT, 20:27 IST: Australia have taken the series with a game to spare. They win by 84 runs. They outbatted the hosts today. Australia plundered runs and with the ball were so clinical that the hosts never ever came close. The top 8 batter from Zimbabwe got into double digits but none even got to a fifty. And in such a big chase, they needed someone to play deep and fast as well. But none happened. The batters were restrained by some very accurate bowling. Stanlake got injured but the depth in the Aussie squad ensured they didn't miss him much. Almost 30 overs were shared by the spinners and almost all of them bowled with pretty good control. Zimbabwe would be disappointed as they haven't been able to put up a fight today. Australia as expected were very dominant.
Australia have taken the series. They were supposed to do so. And they have done so with aplomb. Zimbabwe will look to play for pride. We wil be back soon with more cricketing action. Bye for now.
